events.title: Unwell Demo Update - A Deeper Descent into Horror
events.summary: The Well has changed. events.title: Demo update!

events.title: EARLY ACCESS IS COMMING SOON !
events.summary: EARLY ACCESS COMING SOON!We’re getting close.Unwell will be launching in Early Access soon -and to mark the moment, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer built specifically for this milestone.This is just the beginning of the descent. More updates, more content, and more of The Gray await.Watch the trailer. Stay with us. And get ready.-Head Protégé

events.title: New Feature: Loot System
events.summary: Exploration in Unwell has become much more rewarding.We've implemented a brand-new loot system, allowing you to search through abandoned furniture, forgotten containers, and remnants of a world consumed by The Gray. events.title: Polish localization alongside a massive dose of survival

You can always change the language later in the main menu settings.I remember the first time I launched a game in Polish as a kid. events.title: Update from the Abyss: The Protagonist Gains Momentum!
events.summary: Hello, fellow well dwellers. We know you're waiting for version 1.0, but we haven't forgotten about the current content! We've just introduced several important fixes and improvements. What's new? Improved movement physics – moving our protagonist is now smoother and more intuitive. Revised UI – UI elements now appear and disappear exactly when they should, providing a better gameplay experience. Collision bug fixes – we've removed a few spots where you could unexpectedly fall through the floor.
